lines.text: Honest chart. Real finding. Now — turn it into something Priya can act on.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I had all the pieces. The UI change drove 70 percent of the spike. Reverting it recovers those tickets.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: That's a finding. Not a recommendation.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: A finding tells you what happened. A recommendation tells you what to do.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: First try — I wrote everything I knew. Two hundred words. Context, pattern, root cause, what it implied.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I showed it to Marco. He read three sentences. Tabbed away.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Priya has seven minutes. She'd never finish this. Explaining isn't recommending.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Second try — tighter. But I got careful.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: "We should consider reverting. It may be worth exploring a rollback."
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Marco read it. Looked at me. Said — okay, so what do you want me to do?
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I'd made him translate. Hedging isn't recommending.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Third try — I stopped being careful.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: One sentence. Revert the Cancel button in the December 14 release. Forty engineering hours. Thirty-five percent ticket reduction. Downside — tiny dip in a tap-through that was never a KPI.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Marco read it. Tapped the screen. Said — yes, this.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Every real recommendation has four parts.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: What to do. What it costs. What it's worth. What the downside is.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: All four — reader decides. Miss any — they come back with questions.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Before I sent it, I ran it against three checks. One sentence. All four parts. Can Priya act on it in thirty seconds.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: At Airbnb — your write-up lives or dies on the recommendation line.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Make it a decision someone can sign in thirty seconds.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Your turn.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I'll show you findings and drafts. Pick the one someone can actually act on.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Nice. Now — here's one of your own.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: You've been analyzing Airbnb refund-dispute tickets. You found the April 15 policy change drove the spike.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: You have the findings. Jordan — your manager — needs the recommendation. Use Claude to iterate. I'll be watching.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Try it your own way first. Whatever feels natural.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Good start. Now let me teach you the sharp moves.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Give Claude the findings and context. Ask for a one-sentence draft. Then iterate — strip the hedging, add the numbers, match it to the three checks.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: When all three boxes are green — send it back.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Finding to recommendation. You just closed the loop.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Next — how do you package it so the VP actually reads it.
lines.speaker: avery
